title: Cancellation reason and audit trail

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /orders/{id}/cancel accepts an optional reason from CUSTOMER_REQUEST, DUPLICATE, FRAUD_SUSPECTED, OTHER; the reason is returned by GET /orders/{id}.
An unknown reason is rejected with 422 INVALID_REASON and the order is not cancelled.
Reason OTHER requires a reason_note of 1-280 characters, otherwise 422.
Each cancellation creates an audit entry (actor, timestamp, reason, reason_note?) visible to the order owner and support, not to other customers; entries are returned newest first.
clarifications: CL-1: visibility = owner + support role; other customers get 403
CL-2: GET /orders/{id}/audit returns newest first (seq descending)

untrusted_text.description_md: Support needs to know why orders are cancelled. Cancellations should be auditable. Contract: specs/openapi.yaml (CancelRequest, AuditEntry).
